subject.title: Feature: force media delivery as document attachment (e.g. #doc)

question: Should OpenClaw support force-document behavior beyond the current per-call `forceDocument`/`asDocument` knobs, and if so should the public contract be `MEDIA:#doc`, a channel-level default, or a narrower channel-specific feature?
rationale: The remaining change would create either new model-facing media syntax or new channel config/default behavior, and repository policy treats both as compatibility-sensitive product/API choices rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Keep per-call canonical
options.body: Keep `--force-document` and `asDocument` as the supported contract for now and require a maintainer-sponsored narrower proposal before adding syntax or config defaults.

options.title: Define `MEDIA:#doc` syntax
options.body: Specify fragment parsing and media-kind semantics in the shared media pipeline, then thread the hint through affected channel delivery paths with focused tests and live proof.

options.title: Add default-off channel setting
options.body: Design a per-channel or per-account default with explicit override behavior, docs, upgrade proof, and live Telegram/WhatsApp validation.

recommendation.title: Keep per-call canonical
recommendation.body: Keep `--force-document` and `asDocument` as the supported contract for now and require a maintainer-sponsored narrower proposal before adding syntax or config defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a public source-contract/config direction decision across the paths where Peter has the strongest recent and broadest history.
